text:
Booking an apartment in Osaka for your group? Check this before you pay. 🏠

Short-term rentals in Japan need a registration or a special-zone certification, and legal hosts must record your passport at check-in. Osaka City stopped taking new special-zone applications on 29 May 2026 and has been inspecting rentals more closely, so unlicensed listings are more likely to be cancelled at short notice.

Our 3-step check:
1️⃣ Find the registration or certification number on the listing. No number, no booking.
2️⃣ Expect a passport check. A host who never asks for ID is a warning sign.
3️⃣ Add cleaning fees and taxes for every night before you compare with hotel rooms.

Only 2–3 nights? Two twin rooms near a station are usually easier: two bathrooms, daily cleaning, easy cancellation. Four nights or more? An apartment hotel often wins.
